note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 27 November 2026, RealHunt lists 37 homes for sale in Sweden, each one checked by a person.
In Sweden, the median asking price of those 37 homes is €72,000 (€800 per m², from the 21 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €22,000 and the most expensive €178,900.
Taxes and fees add about 1.5–3.5% to the price of a home in Sweden (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: Stamp duty on the title (lagfart) of 1.5% of the price or tax value, whichever is higher, plus a SEK 825 fee; if you borrow and need new mortgage deeds (pantbrev), 2% of their amount plus a SEK 375 fee; optional legal advice; the seller normally pays the agent, and a cooperative flat (bostadsrätt) has no lagfart.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. There are no citizenship or residence rules for buying a home in Sweden, but you need a Swedish personal identity number or coordination number (samordningsnummer) to register ownership.
buying.annual_property_tax: Houses pay a municipal property fee (kommunal fastighetsavgift) of SEK 10,425 in 2026, or 0.75% of the tax value if that is lower.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-resident individuals pay 30% tax on net rental income as capital income; for a private home you can first deduct SEK 40,000 per property and 20% of the rent (the 20% does not apply to a bostadsrätt).

homes.title: Cosy villa with sauna, 100 m from the river
homes.title_es: Villa acogedora con sauna, a 100 m del río
homes.summary: Cosy villa with a sauna, a big garden house and a garage, in a quiet spot 100 m from the river and 800 m from the lake.

homes.title: Cottage on 6,148 m² of garden and woodland near two lakes
homes.title_es: Casita en 6.148 m² de jardín y bosque cerca de dos lagos
homes.summary: The kind of place where you could slow down a little. Set on a generous 6,148 m² plot of garden and woodland, the house is surrounded by peaceful countryside close to both Stora Blanken and Ljusterhövden lakes.

homes.title: Three-bedroom brick townhouse with a garden near the south coast in Skivarp
homes.title_es: Adosado de ladrillo de tres dormitorios con jardín cerca de la costa sur en Skivarp
homes.place: Skivarp, Skurup, Skåne (about 60 min from Copenhagen)
homes.summary: A 102 m² 1950s brick townhouse on a quiet, leafy cul-de-sac in the village of Skivarp: generous ceiling heights, stone stairs, a living room with a tiled stove, a dining kitchen and three good bedrooms, plus a sunny glazed garden room and a private garden plot. District heating. A few kilometres from the beaches at Mossbystrand and Abbekås. Swedish co-op (bostadsrätt) with a monthly fee of 5,700 SEK (about €510). Asking 695,000 SEK (about €62,300), about €611/m².

homes.title: Two-apartment house with river swimming spots and geothermal heat
homes.title_es: Casa con dos viviendas, pozas en el río para bañarse y calefacción geotérmica
homes.summary: A flexible 156 m² house that can be one generous home or keep its current setup of two separate 3-room living areas, one per floor. Both floors have their own kitchen, living room with fireplace, two bedrooms and a renovated bathroom.

homes.title: Charming wooden house in the forest near a lake
homes.title_es: Casa de madera con encanto en el bosque cerca de un lago
homes.summary: Charming house with wooden floors and stoves, set in the forest 200 m from the river and 550 m from the lake.

homes.title: Through-flat with three bedrooms and a sunny balcony in Malmö
homes.title_es: Piso pasante de tres dormitorios con balcón soleado en Malmö
homes.summary: An 84 m² through-flat on the 6th floor with a lift and open views over the area: a spacious living and dining room, three good bedrooms, a fresh kitchen, two toilets and a big sunny balcony. Light floors and bright white rooms, ready to move into. Swedish co-op flat (bostadsrätt) with a monthly fee of 7,586 SEK (about €680). Copenhagen is about 40 minutes by car over the Øresund bridge. Asking 750,000 SEK (about €67,200), about €800/m².

homes.title: Renovated red wooden villa with wide valley views near Fränsta, Västernorrland
homes.title_es: Villa de madera roja renovada con amplias vistas del valle cerca de Fränsta, Västernorrland
homes.summary: Asking 750,000 SEK (about €68,000) for a 116 m² two-storey wooden house from 1915 on a 2,820 m² plot, under €600 per m². The advert says you can move straight in: kitchen, bathroom and surfaces were renovated in 2016, the wiring was recently updated and fibre broadband is connected. Downstairs are a kitchen with island and old wood stove, a dining room, a living room with fireplace and a tiled stove, and a shower room. Upstairs are two bedrooms. A garage and barn give storage, and the house looks out over a wide green valley. Running costs 36,085 SEK a year.

homes.title: Swedish villa with a glazed porch and big garden in Gnarp
homes.title_es: Villa sueca con porche acristalado y gran jardín en Gnarp
homes.summary: A well-kept six-room villa with four bedrooms, a glazed porch, a living-room stove and a wood-burning kitchen range, on a 1,050 m² plot. Bathroom and drainage renewed in 2010, heat pumps installed. Asking SEK 945,000, about €82,000.

homes.title: Historic lakeside farm on 1.1 hectares
homes.title_es: Granja histórica junto al lago en 1,1 hectáreas
homes.summary: Large, charming country house with wooden floors and stoves on 1.1 hectares by a lake, 4 km from the village centre.

homes.title: 1948 home near the Kornsjön lakes
homes.title_es: Casa de 1948 cerca de los lagos Kornsjön
homes.summary: Lake views, forest on the doorstep and a house that already comes with some surprisingly practical upgrades. This 1948 home sits close to the Kornsjön lake system, making it an interesting option for anyone dreaming of swimming, fishing and a quieter everyday life surrounded by nature.

homes.title: 1920s villa with geothermal heating and a private garden in central Vansbro, Dalarna
homes.title_es: Villa de los años 20 con calefacción geotérmica y jardín privado en el centro de Vansbro, Dalarna
homes.summary: A 1920s house in the middle of Vansbro, on the Västerdal river in Dalarna, with a sheltered 1,651 m² plot next to a playground. 122 m² with five rooms, three of them bedrooms, a separate dining room, a bright living room with a stove and a bathroom between the two upstairs bedrooms. Geothermal heating was installed in 2019, the incoming water pipe was renewed in 2023 and the windows are triple glazed. School, shops, pharmacy, swimming pool and the bus and railway station are within walking distance. Freehold. Asking 850,000 SEK (about €77,000), around €630/m².

homes.title: Family townhouse with a garden and a glass room in Eslöv
homes.title_es: Adosado familiar con jardín y galería acristalada en Eslöv
homes.summary: A 117 m² townhouse on two floors in a well-run, car-free association in Eslöv: a living room opening onto the garden, a kitchen with an island, a utility room, a shower room and a bedroom downstairs; two more bedrooms, a landing and a second bathroom upstairs. A south-facing deck at the front, a hedged garden with another deck and a glass room at the back. Built in 1988 and well kept. Swedish co-op (bostadsrätt) with a monthly fee of 9,303 SEK (about €830). Asking 1,050,000 SEK (about €94,100), about €804/m².

homes.title: Bright 1929 flat with three bedrooms near the centre of Landskrona
homes.title_es: Piso luminoso de 1929 con tres dormitorios junto al centro de Landskrona
homes.summary: A 110 m² second-floor flat from 1929 a stone's throw from the centre of Landskrona: a large hall, three proper bedrooms, a big living room with a bay window, a modern kitchen and a fully tiled shower room with washer-dryer, plus two storerooms and a stairwell balcony over a leafy courtyard. High ceilings, parquet and big windows, in move-in condition. It is a Swedish co-op flat (bostadsrätt) with a monthly fee of 9,665 SEK (about €870). Trains reach Copenhagen in about 50 minutes. Asking 1,095,000 SEK (about €98,100), about €892/m².

homes.title: Classic 1914 red house with four bedrooms across three levels
homes.title_es: Clásica casa roja de 1914 con cuatro dormitorios en tres plantas
homes.summary: Dating back to 1914, this charming red house offers four bedrooms, bright interiors and plenty of space for family life across three levels. A generous garden provides room for growing, playing and long summer days outdoors, while modern upgrades make the home comfortable year-round.

homes.title: Traditional timber cottage with sauna on 2,547 m² of nature
homes.title_es: Casita tradicional de madera con sauna en 2.547 m² de naturaleza
homes.summary: Surrounded by nature on a generous plot, this is the kind of place where mornings begin with birdsong, afternoons are spent in the garden and evenings end beside a wood-burning stove.

homes.title: 1917 Forest Cottage with a swimming lake five minutes away
homes.title_es: Cabaña forestal de 1917 con un lago para nadar a cinco minutos
homes.summary: A 1917 Swedish cottage in Småland called Skogshyttan, the Forest Cottage, with a forest literally at the back door and a swimming lake five minutes away. Växjövägen 8 sits in Linneryd, Tingsryds kommun, on a generous 16,000 sq ft lot with the road out front and old-growth forest behind.

homes.title: Stylish three-bedroom flat with a 2023 kitchen in central Eslöv
homes.title_es: Piso con estilo de tres dormitorios y cocina de 2023 en el centro de Eslöv
homes.place: Central Eslöv, Skåne (about 55 min from Copenhagen)
homes.summary: A 90.5 m² ground-floor through-flat in the middle of Eslöv: a bright hall, a large living room, three bedrooms (one opening onto a balcony over a quiet courtyard), a sleek 2023 kitchen with room for a dining table and a fully tiled bathroom, plus an attic storeroom. Walking distance to Eslöv station, with trains to Lund, Malmö and Copenhagen. Swedish co-op flat (bostadsrätt) with a monthly fee of 9,399 SEK (about €840). Asking 1,095,000 SEK (about €98,100), about €1,090/m².

homes.title: 1926 character home with a full home spa, sauna and geothermal heating
homes.title_es: Casa con carácter de 1926 con spa completo, sauna y calefacción geotérmica
homes.summary: Built in 1926, this house has kept plenty of older Swedish character, with tall windows, wooden floors, a fireplace and a large country-style kitchen, alongside practical upgrades. Downstairs there is a full home spa added in 2019 with a whirlpool bath, spacious sauna and underfloor heating.

homes.title: House on 7,600 m² with a new guest cabin
homes.title_es: Casa en 7.600 m² con cabaña de invitados nueva
homes.summary: Set on nearly 7,600 m² of private land, this house offers peaceful surroundings, a spacious terrace, and a newly built guest cabin that’s perfect for visitors, hobbies, or a creative workspace.

homes.title: Simple lakeside holiday cottage with extra sleeping cabins
homes.title_es: Sencilla casita de vacaciones junto al lago con cabañas extra para dormir
homes.summary: Set near the lake Mellansjön and surrounded by forest, the property has a simple main cottage, extra sleeping spaces in separate outbuildings and plenty of room outside for swimming, fishing and idling. Used by the same family for many years, with the cabins making a relaxed setup for hosting friends or family.

homes.title: Red wooden three-bedroom house with conservatory and greenhouse in Arbrå, Hälsingland
homes.title_es: Casa de madera roja de tres dormitorios con invernadero y galería en Arbrå, Hälsingland
homes.summary: A classic red wooden house with white corners in a central, child-friendly part of Arbrå, in Hälsingland. 108 m² on one and a half floors with four rooms, three of them bedrooms, a modern fully equipped kitchen, a shower room downstairs and a bathroom with bath upstairs. Surfaces have been renovated over time, two sides of the facade were painted in 2025 and the dishwasher is new in 2026. Glazed conservatory, greenhouse and carport on a 515 m² plot, district heating. Freehold. Asking 795,000 SEK (about €72,000), around €670/m². Running costs 37,524 SEK a year (about €3,400) plus property fee 4,920 SEK.

homes.title: Renovated 1920s villa with a glazed veranda and double garage in Lenhovda, Småland
homes.title_es: Villa de los años 20 renovada con galería acristalada y garaje doble en Lenhovda, Småland
homes.summary: Asking 2,000,000 SEK (about €178,900) for a 138 m² wooden villa from 1920 with a mansard roof, about €1,300 per m². The advert calls it renovated and ready to move into: in 2026 it got new insulation, part of a new floor structure and underfloor heating with new floors in the hall, kitchen and dining area. It has a ground-source heat pump from 2018, triple glazing, four bedrooms, two renovated shower rooms, a white kitchen, an open fireplace and a tiled stove. The 1,257 m² hedged garden has fruit trees, a deck, a large glazed veranda and an insulated 80 m² double garage. Running costs 39,344 SEK a year.

homes.title: Sea-view cabin with swimming access and boat mooring
homes.title_es: Cabaña con vistas al mar, acceso para bañarse y amarre para barco
homes.summary: A compact cabin all about its setting. Positioned high on a sloping natural plot, it looks out toward the sea and catches the evening sun, with swimming access and a boat mooring just below the property.

homes.title: 155 m² home with two greenhouses, own irrigation well and double garage
homes.title_es: Casa de 155 m² con dos invernaderos, pozo propio para riego y garaje doble
homes.summary: Set in the small community of Åfors, this 155 m² home comes with generous outdoor space, several practical buildings and plenty of room for hobbies and gardening. The garden is especially appealing for growers, with two greenhouses and a separate well for irrigation.

homes.title: 1927 country home with glazed sunroom and geothermal heating on 2,880 m²
homes.title_es: Casa de campo de 1927 con solárium acristalado y calefacción geotérmica en 2.880 m²
homes.summary: This 1927 country home sits among forest and open fields, with a sunny garden, a large deck and a newly built glazed sunroom that extends the outdoor season. Inside there is a bright country-style kitchen, three bedrooms and flexible living space that could become a fourth bedroom.

homes.title: Well-kept family home on a big plot
homes.title_es: Casa familiar bien cuidada en una parcela grande
homes.summary: Sometimes it’s the practical homes that offer the biggest opportunity. Set on a spacious plot surrounded by the beautiful nature of Gunnarskog, this well-maintained home gives you room to settle into Swedish country life without taking on a long renovation project.

homes.title: House renovated since 2017, with big garages
homes.title_es: Casa reformada desde 2017, con garajes grandes
homes.summary: For anyone who needs serious space for cars, tools, or hands-on projects, this one stands out. The listing describes the house as extensively renovated since 2017, including a new kitchen, bathroom, guest toilet, façade, added insulation, and triple-glazed windows.

homes.title: Woodland summer cabin with guesthouse and swimming lakes nearby
homes.title_es: Cabaña de verano en el bosque con casa de invitados y lagos para bañarse cerca
homes.summary: A summer cabin in the woods at Vivljunga, Kronoberg, Sweden, with a separate guesthouse, two bedrooms and lakes for swimming nearby. Asking about €71,000.

homes.title: Three-bedroom home with sauna, guest cabin, two heated garages and a 2025 sunroom
homes.title_es: Casa de tres dormitorios con sauna, cabaña de invitados, dos garajes con calefacción y solárium de 2025
homes.summary: A single-storey home with a practical layout: three bedrooms, two terraces and a newly glazed sunroom from 2025. Useful extras include a sauna, a guest cabin and two heated garages, one of them a separate 29 m² building for storage, a workshop or vehicles.

homes.title: Country home with fruit trees, a barn and a stable
homes.title_es: Casa de campo con frutales, granero y establo
homes.summary: If you’ve been looking for a Swedish country home with room to dream, this one is worth a closer look. Set on a generous garden surrounded by fruit trees and peaceful nature, it also comes with a traditional barn, stable, workshop, and plenty of space for hobbies or small-scale projects.

homes.title: 5-bed 1929 house a short walk from Lake Lelång
homes.title_es: Casa de 1929 con 5 dormitorios a un paseo del lago Lelång
homes.summary: If you want space, this one has plenty of it. Built in 1929, the house has five bedrooms and sits on a private 4,631 m² plot surrounded by nature, with Lake Lelång just a short walk away for swimming and fishing.

homes.title: Family house on a green riverside plot
homes.title_es: Casa familiar en una parcela verde junto al río
homes.summary: Older family house with all comforts on a green plot by a river, at the end of a village in Småland.

homes.title: 1909 house in an old leafy garden
homes.title_es: Casa de 1909 en un jardín antiguo y frondoso
homes.summary: Anneberg, Jönköping · €73.000 There is something quietly lovely about a 1909 house surrounded by an old, leafy garden. The listing describes it as well cared for, with a bright kitchen, welcoming living room, and a deck that opens onto 1,548 m² of lawns, flowering shrubs, and mature trees.

homes.title: Former railway keeper's cottage with mountain views
homes.title_es: Antigua casa de guardavías con vistas a la montaña
homes.summary: This one comes with a little piece of Swedish railway history. Originally used as a railway keeper’s home, the 50 m² cottage sits among open fields with views towards the forest and mountains, surrounded by a leafy 1,385 m² garden.

homes.title: 1922 homestead with four bedrooms, orchard garden and workshop barn
homes.title_es: Granja de 1922 con cuatro dormitorios, huerto de frutales y granero taller
homes.summary: Sandbacken has the feel of a small Swedish countryside homestead. Built in 1922, the house keeps plenty of original character and offers five rooms across two floors, including four bedrooms and a bright kitchen with an old-fashioned walk-in pantry.

homes.title: Red 1870 stuga with a garden near Torsebro
homes.title_es: Stuga roja de 1870 con jardín cerca de Torsebro
homes.summary: Falu rödfärg isn't a colour, it's a worldview. Woodsmoke, slow mornings, crimson quiet. This 1870 stuga outside Torsebro is the whole creed in 678 ft². Charming inside and out with four little rooms, a 521 m² garden, and nowhere else you need to be. We'd shut the door, light the stove, and kickstart a new life.

homes.title: Bright village home with countryside all around and trains minutes away
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo luminosa rodeada de campo y con el tren a pocos minutos
homes.summary: Set in a peaceful rural setting near Vedum, Sweden, this welcoming home offers bright living spaces, a practical layout and an easy-to-maintain garden for relaxed everyday living.
